generations.name: First generation
generations.notes: Launch: 64 kWh pack in North America; DC up to ~77 kW. Wikipedia gives no North American model years for the EV; 2019-2022 is from general knowledge (US launch as a 2019 model) and should be checked against fueleconomy.gov. Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kia_Niro

generations.name: Second generation
generations.notes: All-new body: 64.8 kWh pack, DC up to ~94 kW, 11 kW AC. last_year 2026 in both CA and US, from press reports (Kia executives to the Korea Herald; Kia Canada confirmation reported Oct 2026). No formal Kia North America end-of-production notice found. Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kia_Niro ; https://insideevs.com/news/789628/kia-niro-ev-dead/ ; https://driveteslacanada.ca/news/kia-niro-leaving-canada-2026/ ; https://cars.com/articles/hyundai-pauses-kona-electric-for-2026-kia-discontinues-niro-phev-521230/
